description: Van Breestraat 119-137 (1900-1901): 6 m red brick fronts of three storeys under a brick cornice frieze at 10.4 m; three axes of two-light windows with a top light and white sills; the centre axis French windows with iron balconettes on stone slabs and corbels on storeys 1 and 2; a round-arched house door on the left axis beside two ground windows with transoms; over the centre a brick wall gable 3.4 m wide rising to 14.4 m with one attic light, alternately stepped, bell-topped with a flat cap, or pointed; a slate attic storey with dormers behind the cornice between the gables

step-gable.note: 123, 129, 133, 135 (160540, 163068, 161182, 163560): a 3.6-3.9 m gable on plumb sides to about 12.4 m, then steps to a flat coping 1.2 m wide at 14.4 m; drawn as three equal steps (risers 1.3 m, treads 0.45 m), the nearest the step outline says

bell-gable.note: 119, 121, 125, 127 (157652, 158648, 160169, 157147): a 3.9 m gable rising near plumb from the cornice and curving in at the top (volutes) to a flat coping 2.0 m wide at 14.4 m: convex flanks meeting a short neck at 0.85 of the rise

point-gable.note: 131, 137 (163680, 161806): a pointed gable, its rakes from 10.9 to 14.4 m

door-left.note: every house of 119-137: a round-arched house door on the left axis, the arch crown at 3.3 m; two ground windows with a transom (1.0-3.2 m)

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 two-light windows with a top light; the centre a French window behind a balconette on storeys 1-2
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; door always left
rhythm.roofline: brick cornice frieze at 10.4 m; a centred wall gable to 14.4 m (step, bell or point); an attic storey with dormers between the gables

match.note: Van Breestraat 119-137 on the 2024-11-12 strip (40 px/m, gridded 1 m): 3DBAG eaves 14.0-14.4 m and roof max 14.3-17.1 m are the flat attic storey behind the cornice and the gable tops; the front cornice is 10.4 m. One house per pand, 5.6-6.5 m. The skyline reads the gable tops (13.9-14.7 m on 119, 123, 129; frontSkylineM 14.4) or, on 135-137, the attic storey top between them (12.3-13.4 m); under the bare branches does not tell the three gables apart: the crown is pinned per pand in cornelis-schuytbuurt-review-crowns.json
